fact: Car 4 was not in the correct starting position.
offence: Breach of Article 48.1 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that part of the contact patch of Car 4's front right tyre was outside the line of the grid box at the time of the Start Signal. This is a breach of Article 48.1 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. This attracts a mandatory time penalty under Article 54.3 of the Sporting Regulations. Given the limited extent of the breach, we determined that a 5-second time penalty was appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 4 Incorrect Starting Position
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Formula 1 Team
